review: The canonical physical split lists bad coordinates before good coordinates. The chosen Finset.equivFin enumeration pairs q and t from the same good copy. The actual partial trace discards all good T coordinates and every bad Q×T coordinate; it retains good Q and the whole auxiliary C. The RHS is the original one-copy Q marginal tensor power and the actual marginal of that same excitation component. Only the one-copy vector is unit. k=0, B=univ, B=empty and zero components are included by empty products and singleton empty configurations. Good-auxiliary restriction, permutation symmetry and subsequent merge moments remain separate. The finite-set equivalence is not asserted to preserve numerical order.
